sources.finding: Existing IConfiguration supports provider-independent sections, hierarchical keys and last-added-provider precedence; .NET 10 example verified. No .NET 11-only APIs are used.
Validation of nested configuration must be explicit; snapshot parser checks every nested object rather than silently ignoring unknown fields.

implementation_impact: Reuse existing framework Configuration and DI. No new dependency/version, cloud or secret provider is selected.
